TEXT: [FI] A few days have passed within the blink of an eye ever since I started my job as an assistant.
[FI] During that time, I've noticed all sorts of things.
[FI] Friends have more surprising sides than I initially thought.
[FI] Kuroneko's ability to concentrate is really good. How many hours can she draw continuously?
[FI] If it was me, it would definitely be impossible to concentrate like that... is what I used to think in the past...
[FI] I've been working together with Kuroneko, haven't I? I'm being inspired by her.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke～, could you help me wash the dishes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Mom, I'm going to the usual place, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Can't you help me just for a bit? It won't take more than five minutes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If it doesn't take that long, you should do it yourself...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] But, it seems like you have a lot of free time on your hands.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Tch, guess there's no other choice...
[FI] I should be a good son once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Just washing them will do, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, I'm counting on you.
[FI] All right, then I'll quickly get this over with.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Oh, you even wiped all the dishes? Thanks!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm, well, if it's just this much...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm-hmm, Mom is really happy that you've become this nice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Uh... well, it's just this little bit...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] There there. Then I'm counting on you next time as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey...!
[FI] However, well... if this little deed makes her this happy, I guess it's not that bad after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I guess it's fine once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] I see. Thank you, Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Come to think of it, haven't you been acting a little strange recently?
[FI] Guh... well, although I'm aware of that too...
[FI] However, I don't think it'll be good telling my own mother about it. It just feels a little embarrassing... or rather, I'll definitely be teased by her?
[FI] Mom and Dad are different, it'll certainly spread uncontrollably once I tell her, and I can't imagine the results...
[FI] Against one's mother, it's not like I'll give her material to tease me about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I won't continue helping you if you keep trying to flatter me.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] My my, I'm not doing such things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's about time anyway, I have to go already!

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Really. Okay okay, Take care. Say hi to your girlfriend for me～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Like I said, she's not my girlfriend...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It seems I have a really hardworking kouhai.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Uh huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I thought of helping her out. That's why I felt like I need to be hardworking too.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That was a rather lacking response...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So then, I was thinking "Since I have nothing to do, what can I do?".

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah, is that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why are you so surprised?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] That's because I feel that Kyousuke is already doing 【the things that should be done】.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] It seems that you've been rather happy recently, aren't you?  It looks like you're moving towards an goal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-Is that so?
[FI] It feels a little embarrassing when she puts it like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] That child, I don't think she's just a kouhai to you, is she?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What are you saying all of a sudden...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Don't underestimate your mother's eyes, okay? I can see through everything about you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Guh... I-I'm running late! I'm going out!

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my, oh my, he ran away...
[FI] I did notice it a bit when I helped in the creation of that game last time... But this time, I was more involved in the process...? Compared to last time, I
[FI] could really feel it this time.
